Absolutely the best!. After taking a closer look through the app so I could write a proper review, I’ve come to one embarrassing conclusion: I am a TERRIBLE BM app user! 🫣😅
I forget to log my water most days, I don’t use BM to track my meals or plan my food, and I honestly haven’t done the BM workouts in forever. Sorry! ☠️
That said, I can still confidently say that joining BM was one of the best decisions I’ve made for my health. I actually am much better at drinking enough water even when I don’t log it in. Snapping my food and sending it to my coach is the easiest thing ever and was the precursor to faithfully tracking my meals. I’ve tracked 1000+ meals so far to track my daily recommended calorie and macros budget. 

The app itself is well organized, easy to navigate, and provides a great structure for anyone looking to build healthier habits. More importantly, signing up connected me with the perfect coach for me. Through kindness, patience, and gentle encouragement, and NEVER any food shaming, they helped repair my anger, mistrust, and overall negative attitude toward fitness and nutrition based on many diet plans and exercise programs I have done in the past. 
Because of that genuine support, I developed better eating habits, lost weight, started weight training and jump rope training, and have became stronger than I’ve been in a very long time honestly, much stronger than I ever expected to be. Along the way, I also managed to get rid of chronic back, foot, and shoulder pain.
What surprises me most is that I genuinely enjoyed the journey, which makes every good decision I make for myself more sustainable, because I want the steps to a healthier me to be a lifelong life style. When I started, I couldn’t even imagine looking forward to setting new goals. Now I’m excited to keep growing to a better version of me, getting stronger, more limber, and seeing what I can accomplish next. Perimenopause symptoms (weight gain, aches and pains and weakness) were the catalyst for me to say “enough is enough”, but BM gave me a structure and path to take control of my health and changing body.
For me, the biggest success wasn’t just the physical results it was completely changing my relationship with health and fitness. And that’s something I’m incredibly grateful for BM
and my amazing coach!

Pretty Good So Far. I downloaded this app a couple days ago and paid for a few months subscription. I like how it combined fitness sessions/videos with calorie tracking. I do have a few notes that I think could improve the app and keep me using it a while longer.

The food tracking could use a lot of work. Unlike others I've used in the past, mostly MyFitnessPal, you can't input recipes and save them without logging those meals then and there. You have to manually input those things at the time you eat them, which isn't always the most convenient.

Ideally, it'd be nice to be able to create recipes at anytime and add them to meals whenever. Or even scan barcodes after getting groceries and save them to an index of food you have a lot/everyday.

Additionally, I wish the serving measurement was a little better. Not everything I eat is measured and oz and even still, when I put in .3 or .5 oz it auto corrects to 1 oz. I'm unable to put in custom measurements. 

Still liking the app and I feel like the calorie tracker is still mostly accurate, but if I'm to keep paying for a service like this, I'd like to have a little more control to get my portions exactly right.

With that being said, this has been my favorite app of this sort so far, over MAD, Apple Fitness and MyFitnessPal. Everything is in one place and it makes it convenient to stay consistent.
